Jason —

Looping in Ben for the specific test harness details. From a CS perspective, here's a compact proposal for the acceptance test set (we'll add to the MAP sheet):
- Smoke (Days 1–2): endpoint connectivity, auth, and 100 inference sanity checks. Goal: zero functional regressions.
- Functional (Week 1): 1k queries across the 3 target intents; measure correctness (precision@k), confidence drift.
- Scale (Weeks 2–3): 10k sample run (your dataset subset) at the target concurrency to validate 95th P latency and token-cost.
- Stability (ongoing): daily regression checks vs. the baseline prompt set; alerting on >3% degradation in accuracy.

I'll upload a short test-catalog PDF with observable metrics and the pass/fail rubric. If Oakview can confirm the sample data delivery format (CSV vs JSONL) we can pre-build the harness.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Jason / team —

Following up with the more technical acceptance checklist and a minimal runbook snippet. Key items we will validate during the smoke + scale phases:
- 95th percentile latency <= 420ms for median prompt length (validated over 10k tokens).
- Memory/kv cache behavior verified across warm and cold starts (we'll run 5 cold restarts during scale).
- Cost baseline: tokens per inference and total token spend estimate in MAP workbook.
- Output stability: run duplicate prompts at two different times and compute pairwise similarity > 0.92 (we'll provide the metric).

Runbook snippet (excerpt):
---
# smoke-runbook
steps:
  - name: auth-check
    action: curl auth endpoint -> expect 200
  - name: simple-infer
    action: run 100 seeded prompts -> compare to baseline hash
  - name: perf-sample
    action: run 1k parallel requests at concurrency 8 -> collect p95
---

I'll add this snippet into a YAML we can commit to the MAP drive. Also linking our SOC2 summary and the short technical FAQ in the shared drive.

Attachment: oakview-technical-runbook.yaml
